title: 电网升级竞赛：固态变压器登场
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This is a transformer, it may not be a lot to look at, but there's more than meets the eye.
segments.zh: 这是变压器，看似普通，但内有乾坤。

segments.en: It's the key for making sure the world's electricity gets where it needs to go safely and efficiently.
segments.zh: 它是确保全球电力安全高效输送到目的地的关键。

segments.en: But new demands are putting a strain on an increasingly dated system.
segments.zh: 但新的需求正给日益老化的系统带来压力。

segments.en: The reality is that over the last 20 to 30 years, the electric grid, which is the largest, most complex machine humans have built,
segments.zh: 现实是，过去二三十年间，电网——人类建造的最大、最复杂的机器——

segments.en: is also changing at the fastest pace that it has in its history.
segments.zh: 也正以史上最快的速度发生变化。

segments.en: And that's happening because a whole slew of new technologies are being added to the grid.
segments.zh: 这是因为大量新技术正被接入电网。

segments.en: So how do we manage this change? Enter something called the solid state transformer, a fancy, high-tech version of an age-old device
segments.zh: 那么如何应对这一变化？固态变压器应运而生，这是一种古老设备的高科技升级版。

segments.en: that isn't just made up of copper and steel, but uses semiconductor chips and software.
segments.zh: 它不再仅由铜和钢制成，而是使用半导体芯片和软件。

segments.en: Investors are betting hundreds of millions that it could be an important tool in enabling the global energy transition towards electrification and the energy hungry AI boom.
segments.zh: 市场参与者正押注数亿美元，认为它可能成为推动全球能源转型、迈向电气化和满足AI能耗需求的重要工具。

segments.en: This is New Mexico State University's outdoor testbed for a lot of grid modernization technologies.
segments.zh: 这里是新墨西哥州立大学的户外测试场，用于测试许多电网现代化技术。
